description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class that sets up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies for the backend API, specifically allowing a frontend served on localhost:3000 to interact with the backend.

classes.name: WebCorsConfig
classes.description: A configuration class implementing WebMvcConfigurer to set up CORS mappings allowing specific origins and HTTP methods for the API.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the method from WebMvcConfigurer to register CORS configurations, specifically permitting requests from localhost:3000.
